steps.description: Run a script: add a target, focus, calculate, export, apply

params.code:
import os
import resonant
array = project.object("ex-b-array")
target = resonant.scene.add_target(project, "Python focus", position=(0.0, 0.0, 0.05), object_id="demo-h-focus")
resonant.acoustics.focus(project, array, target)
field = resonant.acoustics.field(project, project.object("ex-b-region"))
peak = resonant.analysis.peak(field)
print(f"peak |p| on the plane: {peak['max_pressure']:.1f} Pa")
resonant.io.export_field_csv(field, os.path.join(r"${runDirectory}", "python-field.csv"))
print("exported python-field.csv")
app.apply(project, "Python: focus the array on a new target")
